Turtle vs Shark vs Jellyfish: Which Is O.caption:
Turtle vs Shark vs Jellyfish: Which Is Oldest? 🐢🦈🪼

Ranking three ocean animals by how long their lineage has existed. Sea turtles: oldest confirmed fossil ~120 million years (Cadena & Parham, Desmatochelys padillai). Sharks: fossil lineage back 400+ million years. Jellyfish: fossil lineage ~500–550 million years — older than trees, sharks and dinosaurs. For comparison, modern humans have existed for about 300,000 years. Dates are approximate fossil estimates; scientists continue to debate exact…

Other crabs gather and line up from largest to smallest; when the biggest moves into the new shell, each crab moves into the shell just vacated ahead of it. Scientists call this a 'vacancy chain', documented in several hermit crab species including Caribbean land hermit crabs.

Researchers captured it with high-speed video.
